blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A woman with an arrest warrant for child abuse in Cavite was apprehended in Barangay Maligaya, Gloria, Oriental Mindoro, on Sept. 19. The 24-year-old woman, a resident of Barangay Buong Lupa, Gloria, was arrested by virtue of a warrant of arrest issued by the Family Court, Fourth Judicial Region, Branch 5, Trece Martires City, Cavite, for alleged violation of the Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act.
